f_01KXAFW3TNB38YJ6MSDGX2GQHZ.subject: scheduled_start_date
f_01KXAFW3TNB38YJ6MSDGX2GQHZ.content: Job is scheduled to start on 2026-10-05, leaving 85 calendar days from today (2026-07-12).

f_01KXAFW3TP307Z4W1X92EK2628.subject: addition_footprint_and_program
f_01KXAFW3TP307Z4W1X92EK2628.content: The addition is approximately 30' × 10', two-story, adding basement-level storage and a second-floor primary bedroom, master bathroom, and walk-in closet.

f_01KXAFW3TPFHN0Q1JZACZVTCDA.subject: foundation_spec
f_01KXAFW3TPFHN0Q1JZACZVTCDA.content: Foundation uses continuous 12"×12" concrete perimeter footings, 4" gravel base, vapor barrier, and a 4" reinforced concrete slab; no CMU or full-height foundation wall.

f_01KXAFW3TP3RJMJPQN5DC9YFPM.subject: lvl_beam_spec
f_01KXAFW3TP3RJMJPQN5DC9YFPM.content: One 3-ply 14" LVL beam spanning approximately 15'-6" is required to open an existing load-bearing wall, with temporary shoring included.

f_01KXAFW3TPYBT0QPZ98QP9420Z.subject: roof_new_spec
f_01KXAFW3TPYBT0QPZ98QP9420Z.content: New gable roof at approximately 3/12 pitch ties into the existing 6/12 roof; architectural asphalt shingles, synthetic underlayment, seamless gutters, vinyl soffit included; truss vs. rafter framing is explicitly TBD.

f_01KXAFW3TPZTVAHAAT0F2WWA73.subject: window_and_door_spec
f_01KXAFW3TPZTVAHAAT0F2WWA73.content: Four windows specified (three 36"×60" + one transom) plus up to one new exterior door; vinyl siding to match existing.

f_01KXAFW3TQX12ABAA7VNM3AYBN.subject: electrical_subpanel_spec
f_01KXAFW3TQX12ABAA7VNM3AYBN.content: One new 100A subpanel is in scope; scope explicitly states "assumes existing service can support" — this has not been independently verified.

f_01KXAFW3TQPVGTMDG0HCTNW09F.subject: septic_tdec_scope
f_01KXAFW3TQPVGTMDG0HCTNW09F.content: TDEC septic coordination is required to determine feasibility of relocating existing septic, installing a new tank/leach field, or adding a grinder pump to sewer; septic and grinder costs are explicitly excluded from contract and are a future change order.

f_01KXAFW3TQWNWDK7D57TVH14X7.subject: elevator_shaft_scope
f_01KXAFW3TQWNWDK7D57TVH14X7.content: A 4'×4' elevator shaft is framed within the addition (elevator equipment not in scope); one dedicated 120V/30A circuit for a future elevator is included.

f_01KXAFW3TQGKFB3JF67457TT9E.subject: applicable_codes
f_01KXAFW3TQGKFB3JF67457TT9E.content: Project must comply with IRC 2018 and NEC; local jurisdiction permits and inspections are required.

f_01KXAFW3TQ79P4CQQWBPT66M00.subject: retrofit_hallway_switch
f_01KXAFW3TQ79P4CQQWBPT66M00.content: Scope includes relocating one existing hallway switch with drywall patch, prime, and paint — work within existing structure, not the new addition footprint.

f_01KXAFW3TQN7DWZFP88W0QQGK2.subject: site_demo_scope
f_01KXAFW3TQN7DWZFP88W0QQGK2.content: Site work includes saw-cutting existing concrete walkway sections, removing railroad ties, excavating for footing/slab, and relocating an existing heat pump and electrical disconnect.
